messages.Layout formatting only; formulas are not: Layout formatting only; formulas are not evaluated or semantically validated. Strings, quoted names and comments are preserved. Interpolated strings ($"…") are currently unsupported. Choose your formula’s existing separators.

messages.Preview is sanitized. Images are not fet: Preview is sanitized. Images are not fetched and scripts are not executed. Limit: 50,000 characters.
messages.Uses browser cryptographic randomness. P: Uses browser cryptographic randomness. Passwords include every selected character group; UUIDs are version 4. Results are not stored.
messages.UTC output is explicit. Local output use: UTC output is explicit. Local output uses your browser timezone. UNIX seconds are rounded down when converting from a date.
messages.Hashes exact UTF-8 text, including space: Hashes exact UTF-8 text, including spaces and newlines. SHA-1 is available for compatibility; use SHA-256 or stronger for new work. Hashing is not encryption.
messages.Decoding does not verify the signature o: Decoding does not verify the signature or authorize a user. HS256 signs with your local secret; unsigned tokens have an empty signature. Header and payload are readable, not encrypted.
messages.Five-field cron syntax; schedules are ev: Five-field cron syntax; schedules are evaluated in the selected timezone, including DST. If both day-of-month and day-of-week are restricted, either may match. This previews runs; it does not schedule jobs.
messages.Apply template replaces the visual desig: Apply template replaces the visual design and HTML draft. You can undo the visual change.
messages.Custom HTML is kept separately from the: Custom HTML is kept separately from the visual design. Export uses the active editor. Arbitrary HTML is not converted into blocks.
messages.Preview links open in a new tab. Scripts: Preview links open in a new tab. Scripts are blocked; external images load only when enabled. Export uses email tables and inline styles in visual mode, or preserves your custom HTML in HTML mode. Email clients may render it differently. This tool does not send emails.
